title: Mev Tax Hook
tagline: Taxing Arb bot so that LPs can get the extra income for dealing with the Loss.
description:
Passive LPs bleed to arbitrage. Every time the real price moves on a faster venue, the first
bot to trade against the stale pool price keeps the difference (loss versus rebalancing).
Since UNIfication, LPs also hand part of their fee income to a UNI burn. Paradigm's
"Priority Is All You Need" showed that on a chain with strict priority ordering, a bot racing
to be first must bid roughly the value of the opportunity as its priority fee, so the bid is an
honest signal of extracted MEV. Unichain's Flashblocks made that ordering provable in
2025. I built the hook that reads that bid and hands the money back to the LPs it was
taken from.
how_its_made:
It moves the arbitrage value from the sequencer to the LPs without shrinking it or
touching retail. On 33 hours of real ETH/USDC minute prices replayed through the actual
hook and PoolManager, the same $162 of arbitrage value left the pool either way; without
the hook 95% of it was priority fees to the sequencer, with the hook 86% was donated to
LPs, LP income rose 11.8%, and 0 of 399 retail swaps were taxed. Unique execution: the
tax is charged through a beforeSwapReturnDelta and donated through

PoolManager.donate in the same call, so the credit and debit cancel inside the flash-
accounting lock and the contract has no ERC20 code at all. It cannot hold funds, so it

cannot lose them, and donations sit outside the protocol fee switch so all of it reaches
LPs. No oracle, no AVS, no FHE, no second chain. Six additions harden it: a clamped
rolling-average exemption, absolute caps, an immutable hard ceiling, a price-impact
surcharge, a backrun rebate and a PFDA coexistence discount. Live on Unichain Sepolia
with a frontend where anyone can send the same swap as four bidders and watch the tax
land with the LPs.
auto_summary: This project implements a Uniswap v4 hook that taxes high-priority-fee swaps and donates the proceeds to LPs.
